description: This is a Java source file implementing an Android activity (ColorMatrixSample) that demonstrates the use of ColorMatrix for image color adjustments, including contrast and translation effects. The activity contains an inner class (SampleView) which handles drawing a bitmap with various color filters animated over time.

classes.name: ColorMatrixSample
classes.description: An Android activity class that sets up the view for color matrix demonstration.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: An inner class extending View responsible for rendering bitmaps with color matrix effects and animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setTranslate
methods.description: Sets the color matrix to translate colors by specified deltas for red, green, blue, and alpha channels.

methods.name: setContrast
methods.description: Adjusts the contrast of the image by modifying the color matrix with a contrast scale and translation.

methods.name: setContrastTranslateOnly
methods.description: Sets the color matrix to only adjust translation (brightness) based on contrast, without scaling.

methods.name: setContrastScaleOnly
methods.description: Sets the color matrix to only scale (contrast) without translation.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of bitmaps with different color filters applied, updating the contrast dynamically for animation.
